Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

I will validate the requested near-threshold eta kinematics against the configured EXCLURAD table and beam constraints before generating a byte-compatible input, then record the decision in `outcome.json`.
